name: Hazuki You
source:
You is known to others as someone who puts women above men, the "enemy of men". With this, he is quite good with women, and is popular among them.

You is free-spirited, unrestrained, and laid-back. He can also be very vague, the kind of person who ends up toying with other and causing them trouble. However, while he appears to be flashy and troublesome, he possesses a strong sense of duty and one-track mind, although according to him, he would rather die than show that side of him. He also possesses a unique sense of beauty and worldview.
